_note: Verbatim claims per source. Nothing merged, nothing resolved. Each source keeps its own page-stated freshness date. Extracted 2026-08-09 via WebFetch; provenance is the URL, not this file.

sources.quote: Cases in the active pool drop at full rate; cases that rotate out join the rare pool and keep dropping at a much lower rate.
Rare Drop Pool (RDP) - 0 Containers. Currently empty.
Older case appearances are much less common or may no longer be part of the normal weekly rotation, depending on Valve's active pool at that time.
Sometime around January 8-9, 2026, the rare pool simply stopped producing results.
Data-miner: Valve disable rare case drops in CS2. Community data trackers showed exactly 0 rare case drops after January 8-9, 2026. Valve has not made any official statement.

primary_source.method: full-text grep of every post for rare / drop pool / no longer drop / removed <case|container>
primary_source.finding: Valve has never announced removing cases from the drop pool, and has never used the term 'rare drop pool'. The only January 2026 drop-list change in the official feed is about weapon COLLECTIONS, not cases.

structural_events.verbatim: Added two all-new weapon collections to the Weekly Care Package drop list: Harlequin, Achroma. Removed four weapon collections from the Weekly Care Package drop list: Safehouse, Dust 2, 2018 Nuke Collection, and the 2018 Inferno Collection
structural_events.note: these are weapon-skin collections, NOT cases. Affects skin supply, not case supply.

structural_events.why_the_agreement_is_weak: the sources_for are skin-trading SEO sites that republish each other; agreement between them is not independent corroboration. steamdb_droppool is the higher-quality source and disagrees.
structural_events.date_discrepancy: rumour says 2026-01-08/09; the only real January drop-list change Valve shipped was 2026-01-21 and concerned weapon collections. The rumour may be a mis-telling of that change.
structural_events.market_effect_claim: rare case prices +20-40% (claimed by secondary sources, not verified here)
structural_events.resolution_path: mechanical: sell_listings of legacy cases should flatten/fall after the break date while active-pool cases keep rising. Our own daily snapshots (snapshot.py, from 2026-08-09) will settle it forward; retroactive test needs an external listings-history source.

unresolved_disagreements: Does a rare drop pool still exist? steamdb_droppool: yes (35 cases at reduced rate). steam_guide_2981848978 / skinland_rarepool / csgocom_dataminer: no, disabled ~2026-01-08. tradeit_droppool: does not say. 4 sources against 1; steamdb_droppool is the outlier and its wording may describe the pre-January mechanic.
Fever Case: steamdb_droppool = active drop; steam_guide_2981848978 = purchase-only.
Recoil Case / Fracture Case: steamdb_droppool = active drop; steam_guide_2981848978 = discontinued.
Sealed Dead Hand Terminal / Sealed Genesis Terminal: active per steam_guide and tradeit; absent from steamdb active list.
